script.hintMessage:
・Other than [Demonic Beast-type Servants], the blizzard depletes your NP, making it difficult to use Noble Phantasms.
　
・[Demonic Beast-type Servants] possess powerful Special Attacks, so it's advisable to fortify your defenses.
　
・At the final Gauge, Nikitich will deploy consecutive Noble Phantasms, while Koyanskaya of Dark will inflict powerful Debuffs to [Human Servants].

・When an enemy is defeated, the Servant who defeated that enemy will be afflicted with Debuffs.
　
・Bloody Residue has resistance that decreases all damage, and that resistance gets weaker every time enemies are summoned.

・It's adviseable to immediately remove [Invitation to Death] if it is applied by the Bloody Residue. Ignoring it will inflict Death on allied Servants.

・The enemy hermit crab army will apply a powerful resistance against AOE Noble Phantasm attacks to all their allies. 
　
・If you focus too much on attacking the hermit crab army, the other enemies will assault you with powerful attacks, so don't neglect your defenses.
・Try using attacks that can ignore Genbu's high Defense.
・Suzaku will use Burn often.
・Seiryu is highly resistant to every type of attack except Dragon Special Attacks.
・Byakko is highly resistant to every type of attack except Wild Beast Special Attacks.

・Child Servants don't take much damage, but they also can't deal much damage except with their Noble Phantasms.
・The enemy will be buffed if one of your allies falls.

Oda Nobukatsu uses powerful buffs and recovery effects on Demon King Nobunaga. 
　
Until Oda Nobukatsu is defeated, Demon King Nobunaga will continue to employ powerful DEF up buffs.
　
If one of the enemies is defeated, the rest will be strengthened, so be careful!

・The enemy switches between defense and offense whenever you Break their HP gauge.
　
・Caution: The enemy's Special Resist they receive on their second gauge can only be decreased during that gauge.
　
・Incapacitated enemies have Evade activated.

・Charm your opponents by attacking them with the card type they want multiple times.
　
・Noble Phantasms are powerful and easily charged.
　
・In the final Gauge, your opponents gain Special Resist and Noble Phantasm Charge Plus.

・In Battle 1, make sure the ingredients are cooked just right. They shouldn't be overcooked or undercooked.
　
・In Battle 2, the ingredients' freshness is paramount. Try to defeat them as quickly as possible.
　
・In Battle 3, if you have completed the other objectives, the ingredients will lose their Special Resist and become easier to defeat.
　
*Continuing will not be available in this quest.

・The Queen Of Joulupukki hands out presents every turn, but she won't give them to anyone with the [Naughty Child] status.
　
・Those with the [Naughty Child] status can deal extra damage to Joulupukki (Oni), but be careful, as they'll also take extra damage.

・Habetrot will help you out during the battle when Mash uses the Black Barrel, but only once.
　
・NPC Ibuki-Douji has a special effect that will help you during the battle.

・Habetrot will help you out during the battle when Mash uses the Black Barrel, but only once.
　
・Orochi will join the battle and provide numerous helpful effects at regular intervals.

・NPC Ibuki-Douji has a special effect that will help you during the battle.
　
・Orochi will join the battle and provide numerous helpful effects at regular intervals.

・Habetrot will help you out during the battle when Mash uses the Black Barrel, but only once.
　
・NPC Nikitich has a special effect that will help you during the battle.
　
・Orochi will join the battle and provide numerous helpful effects at regular intervals.
・NPC Nikitich has a special effect that will help you during the battle.

・Habetrot will help you out during the battle when Mash uses the Black Barrel, but only once.
　
・NPC Taigong Wang has a special effect that will help you during the battle.
　
・Orochi will join the battle and provide numerous helpful effects at regular intervals.

・El-Melloi II will use his skills to support Alexander.
　
・El-Melloi II has a powerful defensive buff, but defeating Alexander will remove it.

・Gray will increase her ATK and NP charge every turn once her HP gauge is broken.
　
・Sima Yi will support Gray and block their enemies' attacks. She'll receive temporary buffs once her last HP gauge is broken, but those will soon be replaced by debuffs.
　
・The ability to remove debuffs can come in handy against Sima Yi's own abilities.

・Class Affinity has a major effect against the three knights in this quest.
　
・These enemies have a lot of HP, so be sure to take Class Affinity into account when forming your Party.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

・Some skill effects can be removed with Remove Buffs.
　
・Use skills with Evade and Invincible effects to withstand powerful counterattacks.

・During battle, the [Intellect] state can offer beneficial effects.
You deal less damage to enemies when not in an [Intellect] state, so try to maintain it as much as possible.
　
■[Intellect] State...
・Treated as a Buff
・1 State is removed when attacking
・1 State is gained during Noble Phantasm and Critical Attacks
・Some skills can also add [Intellect]

・In this quest, different enemies have different weaknesses, so try to select the most effective Command Cards and aim for maximum damage.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

・Hermit Crabs have powerful defensive buffs.
　
・Damage Plus works well against them, as do Poison, Curse, and Burn.

・At the start of the battle, both parties will be afflicted with ATK Down that will only be removed after enough turns have passed or when an HP Gauge is broken.
　
・A special skill with a random effect (including some that only affect [Female] Servants) will trigger at the start of each turn.
　
・Normal attacks will focus on Male Greek Servants, so use that to your advantage when creating lineup.
・The usual mastermind will buff Mass Production Mk.II with initiative and gauge breaks.

・Santa Alter will buff her allies and give herself card resistances when her HP Gauge is broken.
　
・These Buffs can be removed, so include Buff Removal abilities in your formation.

・Murasaki Shikibu will receive Buffs when book enemies are present, and she will receive more powerful Buffs when one is defeated.
　
・Murasaki Shikibu will resurrect defeated books after a number of turns have passed.

・The enemy will have strong defensive Buffs when the battle begins.
　
・The enemy will also receive offensive Buffs when their HP Gauge is broken.
　
・Make sure you have a way to deal with the enemy's powerful critical attacks.
　
・You will need a plan to deal with the enemy's use of Target Focused and DEF Down.

・This Servant battle includes Servants from multiple classes.
　
・Servants who show up later will have short waits to charge their Noble Phantasms, so make sure the Servants you have at the start have good NP synergy.

・When the battle begins, the enemy will seal away your skills and a random card type.
　
・The enemy will summon clones and remove your Buffs when their HP gauge is broken.

・Master Storm's Guts will be removed by Doll Maid every turn, but he'll also buff his ATK.
　
・God Players won't just buff their allies. They also have a chance to apply Invincible to themselves.
　
・Akibakemono will summon enemies that will inflict Charm when attacked.

・The enemy will inflict Stun and use Target Focused on a random combatant when the battle begins.
　
・The enemy will focus on defense at first, but will remove their defensive Buffs and switch to offense when their HP Gauge is broken.
　
・The enemy will gain a powerful NP Charge every turn once their last HP gauge is broken.

・Love Slave will give [Female] opponents defensive Buffs. For Freed Orion, he will use Evade and Invincible against [Male] and [Divine] opponents.
　
・Embodiment of Desire will give allies powerful offensive Buffs when defeated.
　
・Defeating Freed Orion will give all allies powerful buffs.

・Defeat Utsumi Erice to clear this quest.
　
・The more evil spirits she has, the stronger Utsumi Erice's defensive Buffs will be.
　
・Watch out for Utsumi Erice's Noble Phantasm, as it can inflict Death on your allies.

・The enemy will apply a defensive Buff and recover HP each turn.
　
・The enemy will recover HP if you can't break their HP gauge within a certain number of turns, so make sure your formation is focused on offense.

・Each turn, the idol chosen by the spotlight will activate her special skill.
　
・Each idol will use powerful Buffs and Debuffs when her HP gauge is broken.
　
・Prince Idols will gain a defensive buff when their HP gauge is broken, but it will be removed when there is only one of them left.

・Nikola Tesla will use powerful skills at the end of the enemy's turn depending on how many C. Stars he has!
　
・Each turn, the enemy will decrease your HP and inflict Debuffs on you. You can prevent this by using either Incapacitate or Skill Seal on the two Gilgameshes.
　
・When the enemy's HP gauge is broken, Gilgamesh will apply Buffs, and Nikola Tesla will use Stun-related abilities.

・The enemy will use special skills that decrease your Max HP when the battle begins and at the end of each turn.
　
・The Great Rice Shogun will give you Rice Balls when he attacks. These Rice Balls will increase your Max HP, but also seal your cards.
　
・You can digest the Rice Balls faster by attacking with non-sealed cards. Digesting them will give you helpful benefits.

・Flaming Man's Special Resist will be lowered each time a Soldier is defeated.
　
・Be aware that Flaming Man will debuff any opponent who defeated a certain number of Soldiers whenever his HP Gauge is broken.
　
・Flaming Man will buff Soldiers each turn, so try to defeat him quickly before you're overpowered.

・Every time Crimson Samurai is attacked, he will gain resistance to the card he is attacked with. The effect he gains will change depending on the type of card he was attacked with last.
　
・Crimson Samurai is resistant to Noble Phantasm damage, so try to hit him with normal and critical attacks.
　
・Crimson Samurai's Humanoid Special Attack will be buffed when his HP gauge is broken.

・Be aware that the Servants in this battle are difficult to damage thanks to their resistances to all card types.
　
・In this quest, the last Servant attacked will change the field to an advantageous one which provides them with powerful Buffs.
　
・Even if the Servant doesn't have a field, they can still reduce NP damage, so try to be flexible and adapt your strategy as necessary.
　
・When you break a Servant's HP Gauge, two helpful fields will be put up.

・The Lender will gain a large amount of attack resistance, but if the effect applied to the player's side each turn is removed, that resistance will also be removed.
　
・The Late Fees inflicted each turn have both buffs and debuffs.
　
・Either defeat the enemies or use the buffs to remove the Late Fees inflicted on the player's side.

・Snack Meister will have very high HP after their HP Gauge is broken, but you can defeat them much more easily if you defeat as many other enemies as possible before breaking their gauge.
　
・Each turn, Snack Meister will defeat an enemy and apply both a Buff and Debuff to themself. Figuring out which enemy they'll defeat will be crucial to winning this battle.

・Defeated enemy Servants will use both Buffs and Debuffs, so try to defeat them in the most advantageous order possible.
　
・The Bride of Babylon will buff any enemy Servant that shows up after her.
　
・King Gold will fully restore HP for all enemies and allies when he is defeated. If your party is running low on HP, defeating him could turn the tide for you.

・This quest has two types of Servants, Attackers and Supporters. You can change an enemy Servant's type in numerous ways, such as breaking their HP Gauge or inflicting negative statuses on them, like NP Seal and Incapacitate.
　
・Buffs differ depending on a Servant's type, so try to change your enemies' type to one that helps you.

・Blood Axe King will be given a special skill each turn except the turn he acts, so take advantage of those turns to hit him hard.
　
・If you Charm the Blood Axe King, all of your allies will be inflicted with lots of Disastrous Curse.
　
・Blood Axe King's special skills will have different effects every time his HP Gauge is broken.
　
・Blood Axe King will be given an extremely powerful ATK UP buff when he is on his final HP Gauge.

・The Youngest Gorgon Sister will be summoned if either the Eldest Gorgon Sister or Middle Gorgon Sister's HP Gauge is broken.
　
・The Gorgon Sisters will Charm male Servants and decrease the HP of female ones, so be ready to counteract that with your formation and skills.
　
・Each enemy Servant is resistant to different cards.

・The Devil Clown will inflict Death on you a number of turns after the battle begins.
　
・Other enemies will inflict Target Focus on you while the Devil Clown is around, so be ready to counter that.
　
・Once the Devil Clown's contract expires, he will reappear to renew it.

・Hero Elisabeth will gain levels every time she defeats an enemy.
　
・Every boss is resistant to attack damage from everyone besides Hero Elisabeth, so make sure to support her and help her level up.
　
・You will lose if Hero Elisabeth is defeated, so do your best to keep her alive.

・Swift-Footed Achilles will challenge you to a one-on-one duel when his HP Gauge is broken. Be aware that you won't be able to use skills or Noble Phantasms during that duel.
　
・Duel opponents will be chosen from female Servants, Assassins, and Casters, so you could try to use this against him. However, if your entire formation consists of duel opponents, Swift-Footed Achilles will use his Noble Phantasm every turn. 
　
・Be aware that during a duel, only Divine Servants will be able to easily damage him, and even then, their Noble Phantasm attacks will have little effect.

・The Divine Ancestor will turn your allies into Romans when he is attacked. 
　
・The Divine Ancestor's Rome will expand more quickly the more Romans there are. Be aware that it will be difficult to defeat him if Rome reaches its maximum size.
　
・The Divine Ancestor is resistant to attacks from Roman Servants, but he also provides them with buffs.

・Defeated enemy Servants will use both Buffs and Debuffs, so try to defeat them in the most advantageous order possible.
　
・The Bride of Babylon will buff any enemy Servant that shows up after her.
　
・King Gold will fully restore HP for all enemies and allies when he is defeated. If your party is running low on HP, defeating him could turn the tide for you.

・The Divine Ancestor will turn your allies into Romans when he is attacked. 
　
・The Divine Ancestor's Rome will expand more quickly the more Romans there are. Be aware that it will be difficult to defeat him if Rome reaches its maximum size.
　
・The Divine Ancestor is resistant to attacks from Roman Servants, but he also provides them with buffs.

・Make sure your lineup is balanced and ready for battle with a variety of different classes of Servant.
　
・Enemies will get slightly stronger every turn. Try to defeat them in an optimal order.

・Tweeny Little has a massive amount of HP, but their Max HP will decrease every time they multiply.
　
・When a Little Maid goes away, Tweeny Little will multiply 3 times.
　
・If the battlefield fills up with Little Maids, Tweeny Little will go on Breaktime and start gradually recovering their lost Max HP.

・Class Affinity has a major effect in this quest.
　
・These enemies have a lot of HP, so be sure to take Class Affinity into account when forming your Party.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

・Boss enemies in this quest have a special resistance that reduces their damage taken. Defeating standard enemies will remove this resistance.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

・In this quest, new enemies will immediately replace defeated ones.
　
・Enemies will focus on attacking classes they have an advantage over.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

・In this quest, some enemies will buff their remaining allies when defeated. Try to find the best order to defeat them.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

・This boss enemy possesses powerful resistance to your attacks.
　
・Defeating the golems the boss summons will also reduce the boss's HP.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

・This quest has a turn limit. Complete a Quick, Arts, and Buster Card chain to clear it.
　
*In the Advanced Quest, you cannot use support characters or continues.

- How To Play- 
　
Wolf Game is a game where two sides, the Good Wolves and the Evil Wolves, fight for dominance over the village. 
　
Within the group of werewolves who live in the village, there are several cannibalistic Evil Wolves trying to take control of the village. 
Work with the Good Wolves and find all the Evil Wolves to eliminate them.
　
■Winning Conditions
If all the Evil Wolves are defeated, the Good Wolves win.
You will not be penalized even if a villager on the Good Wolves side is defeated.
　
■Losing Conditions
If the number of survivors in your party is significantly lower than the Evil Wolves, the Evil Wolves win.
Even if someone from your party survives, the Good Wolves side can lose. 
　
■Flow of the Game
　
①At the end of the player's turn, if there are survivors in the enemy's field, 1 enemy suspected to be an Evil Wolf will be expelled from the village.
It will not matter if they are on the Good Wolves' or the Evil Wolves' side.
If there are no survivors on the enemy's field, someone on the player's side will be selected to be expelled. 
　
　↓
　
②At the end of the enemy's turn, if there are survivors on the player's field, 1 Servant will fall victim to the Evil Wolve's poisonous fangs and will leave. 
　
　↓
　
③This process will repeat, and you will win if you manage to expel all the Evil Wolves before the losing conditions are met.
　
■Special Jobs
There are some werewolves who have special abilities. 
　
【Hunter】(Class: Archer)
When a Hunter is on the field, they can protect the player from the Evil Wolves' poisonous fang.
　
【Fortune Teller】(Class: Caster)
When a Fortune Teller is on the field, they can divine whether the other werewolves are Good or Evil. 
　
【Mad Person】(Class: Berserker)
When a Mad Person is on the field, suspicions of an Evil Wolf will also be directed to the player's side, regardless of whether there are survivors on the enemy's side, and the person to be expelled will always be from the player's side. 
　
■How to Find the Evil Wolves
Besides divination, there are signs that hint who's a Good Wolf and Evil Wolf, such as
the Evil Wolves tend to be more aggressive in their attacks than the Good Wolves,
or they may have a “certain affinity...”
Additionally, the location of the Evil Wolves changes every time a quest begins, so pay attention on those details.
